newsitem.title: USA: Lindsey says unsure US growth rate ever acceptable.
newsitem.headline: Lindsey says unsure US growth rate ever acceptable.

text.p: Federal Reserve Governor Lawrence Lindsey said on Friday he was unsure that the U.S. growth rate was ever acceptable and that faster growth was usually desired.
"I'm not sure that we ever have an acceptable rate of economic growth in the sense that we usually want it to grow faster," Lindsey said.
Fed interest rate policy is "about right," Lindsey said at the Atlantic Economic Conference.
"We're about right, I think the markets think so too," Lindsey said in response to a question.
He stressed earlier that his responses did not refer to 25 basis point movements in either direction.
